7 of the 21 runs reset the device; it restarts once the supply recovers to US. BOR and PVD are not configured today (HWSR-505, HWSR-505a).

g.text: Terms: BOR brown-out reset (MCU supply monitor) · DQ-nn decision of the project lead (decision register) · DSR-nn dataset requirement (WP-C-11 §7) · HWSR-nn hardware safety requirement (WP-H-01) · ISO International

Organization for Standardization · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety processor (STM32H7) · PDR power-down reset (MCU supply monitor, the lowest threshold) · PVD programmable voltage detector (MCU supply monitor)

· US United States; in an ISO 16750-2 starting profile, the supply voltage the car settles at after cranking · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware,
W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
